citations.claim: At step 1 the controller force 144.736 exceeds fmax 111.335 - first violation
Body starts at rest so large velocity error demands large force

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise 0.209... to 0.0; raw demand (~kp*vcmd~348N) still exceeds fmax but clamped force now exactly equals fmax so no violation. Shows noise added after/without clamp causes overshoot.

explanation: Large velocity error (rest to ~13.4 m/s toward distant waypoint) demands ~kp*m*|err|~348N > fmax 111.3N. Without noise the controller clamps exactly to fmax (observed 111.335 in counterfactual). With noise=0.209 the reported force is 144.736 > fmax, i.e. seeded sensor noise is added after the fmax clamp (or noisy error is not re-clamped), allowing the limit to be exceeded on the very first step.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body starts in the top-right corner far from the green waypoint in the bottom-left and barely moves between step 0 and step 1. This shows a huge initial distance and velocity error that would demand maximum force immediately, with no collision or wall interaction visible.
